messages:
anya: Quick sync: we need a short runbook for the console/analytics envelope migration. Primary constraints: no dashboard regressions, fast rollback, minimal index bloat.
rohan: agreed. high level: dual-write -> shadow projection -> staged canary. Need per-route mismatch signals.
mike: For dual-write stamp `ingest_version='v2-envelopes'` and a small `route_hash`. Shadow worker can populate a compact `ingest_projection` table to avoid JSON-heavy reads.
jess: Console changes: subtle badge when results are from shadow data + feature-flagged routing toggle. Also add support notification step.
eva: I'll add telemetry: mismatch_ratio and `ingest_migration_toggle` event. Start with 1% deterministic sampling (hash(route_id)%100 < 1) but always include low-cardinality routes.
rohan: Canary plan: 5% for 24h -> 20% for 48h. Abort if mismatch_ratio > 0.02 for routes >1000/day or console p95 increases >25%.
mike: I'll prototype projection DDL and index. Suggest: `CREATE INDEX ix_ingest_proj_route_day ON ingest_projection (route_id, day);` and TTL old rows.
anya: Rollback steps to include exact commands in runbook. Example SQL to flip reads: `UPDATE feature_flags SET value='v1-only' WHERE key='console.ingest.read_mode';` plus admin API toggle.
jess: Add dashboard card: mismatch_ratio, v1/v2 counts, p50/p95 latency delta. Also ping #support-alerts at 20% canary.
ingest-bot: automated: shadow-write cron scheduled for 2024-05-03T02:00Z when flags enabled :gear:
rohan: Also capture a safepoint: export routing metadata used by joins before cutover to speed reconciliation.
anya: I'll write the runbook PR and assign owners: Jess UI, Eva telemetry/ingest changes, Mike projection/index, Rohan rollout controller. Planning to enable dual-write Tue AM pending approvals.
mike: I'll drop DDL in the PR.
eva: Will push metrics and sampling config.
jess: Will prepare console banner and dashboard card.
anya: Thanks all, closing thread.
